event: 43 Copa del Rey MAPFRE - ORC European Championship
procedural_matters: Panel composed as per RRS N1.4(b)
Request heard in the absence of 36940 under RRS 63.1(b)
facts: Several boats requested redress due to incorrect mark colors in that race.
36940 did not request redress as a result of that incident.
The International Jury heard those requests jointly as case 01 on 29.07 17:15.
The decision to grant redress was posted on 29.07 20:00.
36940 lodged a request for redress on 30.07 09:48
36940 alleges an improper action of the International Jury in not granting her redress as the result of case 01.
conclusions: The condiditions of RRS 61.4(b) are not met.
